title: Possible non-revenue inflow
triggerDescription: Credit transaction appears to be director funding, loan, inter-account transfer, refund, or reversal rather than sales.

estimatedImpact.basis: Classify non-sales inflows separately from taxable revenue review.

title: Uncategorized business expense
triggerDescription: Debit transaction remains uncategorized after deterministic classification or user review.

estimatedImpact.basis: Material uncategorized expenses may need support before CIT review.

title: Possible withholding tax credit
triggerDescription: Customer payment appears net of WHT or description mentions WHT.

estimatedImpact.basis: Estimate assumes the receipt may be net of a 5% WHT deduction.

title: Possible input VAT support needed
triggerDescription: Business expense may contain VAT but no valid VAT invoice is linked.
evidenceRequired: valid VAT invoice with supplier tax ID, VAT amount, date, invoice number

estimatedImpact.basis: Estimate uses 7.5% VAT fraction from gross expense amount where VAT evidence may exist.

title: Possible capital asset
triggerDescription: Expense appears to be equipment, laptop, generator, vehicle, machinery, or other asset.

estimatedImpact.basis: Review whether the item should be tracked as an asset rather than a routine expense.
Payroll transactions require PAYE support before filing review.

title: Missing evidence on material expense
triggerDescription: Material debit transaction has no available or uploaded evidence.
evidenceRequired: supplier invoice, payroll schedule, or other primary evidence

estimatedImpact.basis: Estimate flags support risk on material expenses before CIT review.

title: Possible duplicate or reversal pair
triggerDescription: Same-day equal debit and credit pair appears to be an error and reversal.

estimatedImpact.basis: Reversal pairs should be excluded from revenue and expense summaries where appropriate.

title: Standard company scope check
triggerDescription: Turnover band is within the standard-company review scope for this workbench.

estimatedImpact.basis: Confirms the case should remain in the standard-company review workflow.
